$comment: Server-tool fees: what a model provider charges per use of a tool it runs itself, on top of tokens, at list price. Read by servertools.ParseFees. A row prices one tool of one provider (the model's vendor) for the models its globs name (matched on the model id after its last '/', lower case; no globs: every model), the first matching row winning; unit says which count it prices: request (one search, fetch or file search call), query (a Gemini search query), grounded_prompt (a Gemini prompt answered with grounding), container_hour (Anthropic code execution, per container, at least min_minutes), container_session (an OpenAI container of memory_gb, priced per session_minutes and billed by the minute, at least min_minutes) or gb_day (storage, recorded for estimates and never billed: billed false). input_tokens_per_unit adds that many input tokens per unit at the model's input price. free_with lists request tool versions that make the fee 0 (<tool>>=<version>). No free allowance is ever assumed: the providers' free tiers belong to the upstream account, not to one customer.

fees.note: $10 per 1,000 searches; a search that errors is not billed (the upstream does not count it).
No charge beyond the tokens the fetched content adds.

$0.05 per container-hour, 5-minute minimum; free when the request also carries web_search_20260209 or web_fetch_20260209 or later. The 1,550 free hours a month belong to the upstream organization and are never assumed. The response reports no duration, so each container a request names bills the 5-minute minimum, an estimate (usage_estimated), once per request even when the container is reused.
$10 per 1,000 calls; on these mini models search content is billed as a fixed block of 8,000 input tokens per call.
$10 per 1,000 calls, plus search content tokens at the model's rates.
Web search preview on reasoning models: $10 per 1,000 calls.
Web search preview on non-reasoning models: $25 per 1,000 calls; search content tokens are free.
Vector-store storage, $0.10 per GB a day after the first GB. It accrues daily on the account that owns the store (BYOK only), never per request: recorded for run budgets and estimates, never billed.

Hosted shell and code interpreter containers: $0.03 per 20-minute session (1 GB), billed by the minute with a 5-minute minimum. The response reports no duration, so each request bills every container it names at the minimum, an estimate (usage_estimated): a container reused across requests within one session is estimated once per request, above the upstream's one session.
Gemini 3 and later: $14 per 1,000 search queries (one prompt may run several).
Gemini 2.5 and earlier: $35 per 1,000 grounded prompts; with dynamic retrieval only a response that carries a grounding source is charged.
Grounding with Google Maps on Gemini 3 and later: $14 per 1,000.
Grounding with Google Maps on Gemini 2.5: $25 per 1,000.
